title: Cheat Sheet
markdown:
## PE format (lessons 1.03, 1.04)

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| file 0x00 | `MZ` |
| file 0x3C | `e_lfanew` (4 bytes): offset of `PE\0\0` |
| PE + 4 | file header: machine (+0, `8664` x64), sections (+2), optional header size (+16) |
| PE + 24 | optional header: magic (+0, `20B`), entry RVA (+16), image base (+24), data directories (+112) |
| data directory | 0 exports, 1 imports, 2 resources, 3 exceptions (.pdata), 5 relocations, 6 debug, 12 IAT |
| section header (40 bytes) | name (+0), VirtualSize (+8), VirtualAddress (+12), SizeOfRawData (+16), PointerToRawData (+20), flags (+36) |
| section flags | code 0x20, read 0x40000000, write 0x80000000, execute 0x20000000 |

file offset = RVA − section.VirtualAddress + section.PointerToRawData · address = image base + RVA

## Calling convention (lesson 2.01)

| | |
|---|---|
| arguments 1-4 | `rcx`, `rdx`, `r8`, `r9` (or `xmm0`-`xmm3` by position) |
| argument 5+ | `[rsp+28h]`, `[rsp+30h]`, ... on entry |
| return | `rax` / `xmm0` |
| `this` | `rcx` |
| volatile | `rax rcx rdx r8-r11 xmm0-xmm5` |

## Recognising code (lessons 2.02 to 2.05)

| You see | It is |
|---|---|
| `sub rsp, 28h` after pushes | a function prologue |
| run of `CC` | padding between functions |
| jump to a lower address | a loop |
| `cmp ecx, N` / `ja` / indirect `jmp` | a switch jump table |
| `[rcx+18h]` | a member at offset 0x18 |
| `[rax+rdx*4]` | an array of 4-byte elements |
| `movss` / `movsd` | `float` / `double` |
| `jl jg` vs `jb ja` | signed vs unsigned |
| `mov rax,[rcx]` then `call [rax+18h]` | virtual call, slot 3 |
| `.?AVName@@` | RTTI class name |

## Encodings (lessons 4.01, 4.02, 5.01)

| Bytes | Instruction |
|---|---|
| `EB dd` / `E9 dd dd dd dd` | jmp short / near (from the end of the instruction) |
| `70+cc dd` / `0F 80+cc dd...` | jcc short / near; `cc ^ 1` inverts |
| `E8 dd dd dd dd` | call |
| `FF 25 00000000` + 8 bytes | absolute jmp (14 bytes) |
| `90` / `CC` / `C3` | nop / int3 / ret |
| `40`-`4F` | REX: W 64-bit, R reg+8, X index+8, B rm/base+8 |
| ModRM `mod reg rm` | 11 register; rm 100 SIB; mod 00 rm 101 RIP+disp32 |

## Debugging (milestone 3)

| | |
|---|---|
| software breakpoint | `CC` over the first byte; rip −1 on hit |
| hardware breakpoint | DR0-DR3, execute / write / read-write, 1-8 bytes |
| single step | trap flag, bit 8 of EFLAGS |
| names | `module!symbol+offset`, else `module+RVA` |
| x64dbg | F2 breakpoint, F7 into, F8 over, Ctrl+F9 to return |

## Constants worth knowing (lesson 6.01)

| Constant | Algorithm |
|---|---|
| `0xEDB88320` | CRC-32 |
| `0x67452301`, `0xEFCDAB89` | MD5 / SHA-1 start |
| `0x9E3779B9` | TEA, golden-ratio hashing |
| `78 9C` / `78 DA` | zlib stream start |
